source.name: SportsPro: Formula E 2025/26 Commercial Guide – Cupra Kiro
source.note: Commercial guide page without its own date (Formula E 2025/26 season edition); opened 2026-10-03. OMP Racing also lists CUPRA KIRO on its own partner page (ompracing.com/partners/cupra-kiro/).
source.quote: Title partner Cupra Other partners OMP Racing, Reflo

summary: Season 12 (2025/26) Porsche 99X Electric customer car. CUPRA is the team's Co-Title Partner and gives the team its name (front); Duelbits is a Principal Partner, Reflo the Official Teamwear Partner, AQUAME the Official Hydration Partner and OMP Racing a team partner, per the club's own announcements and the club site's 'PROUD PARTNERS' list. Porsche is the powertrain/technical partner, not a commercial kit sponsor. Car-livery placements don't fit the schema yet (see the formula-e league notes).
